cells.gaps: The 79.5% is the BCEAO's overall access rate and is not attributed to a survey. No survey found since November 2023 puts adults who made or received a digital payment at 79% or more.
cells.note: The BCEAO puts the overall access rate to financial services at 79.5% at the end of 2025, four in five or more; not attributed to a survey, staged on it as the ladder is read now, as Senegal's is. No survey gives the share paying digitally.
